independent_reviews.mode: read-only independent review; no source edits, Cargo invocations or external engine execution during this review
independent_reviews.version_boundary: This receipt records an intermediate source_search.rs review and is not relabeled as an exact-final-source review. The attempt comparator, envelope wiring and CLI files in the receipt are byte-identical to the frozen commit.

findings.issue: Missing/null outcome and cost fields could satisfy null equality and imply historical selection or source identity.
findings.resolution: Known completed/budget-exhausted/failed outcome states and typed final/measurement/source identities are required; selection needs a valid successful final match and proven recorded status.

findings.issue: Successful candidate-compile with no decision produced Some(null), which was mistakenly classified as recorded-verified; reachable at evidence-budget boundary.
findings.resolution: Only explicit admitted stages with native observation equal to reproduced baseline grant recorded-verified; native-only record remains not-checked. Meaningful fixture sets final metadata to native-only smaller candidate and requires selected=false.

findings.issue: Producer candidate retention limit could exceed consumer aggregate read cap once mandatory/metadata/event overhead was included.
findings.resolution: Aggregate bounded reader cap increased to 1 GiB, covering maximum 512 MiB optional snapshots plus mandatory inputs and bounded metadata/journal.

findings.issue: Cross-run key omitted baseline native/diagnostic identity and actual working directory.
findings.resolution: Key includes twice-reproduced native observation and canonical working directory; incomplete baseline stays run-local.

findings.issue: Original/final/measured source references could lack retained objects; baseline selection only compared payload hash.
findings.resolution: Required source references resolve to hashed retained objects; final source length and baseline source/cost selection consistency are checked.

findings.issue: Leaf symlink/FIFO race between path metadata and open could defeat bounded regular-file read.
findings.resolution: Open uses O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK, then descriptor metadata verifies a bounded regular file.

independent_reviews.preservation_review: Exact content-addressed original/candidate source objects plus pinned context, journal, and derivation receipts reconstruct attempted source candidates. Snapshot budget stops exploration before unretained candidates are measured/admitted; original and current verified incumbent remain available. Existing paths are not overwritten.
independent_reviews.comparison_review: Comparison validates hashes and ranks historical measurements within matching contexts; no archive commands, compiler, target, loader or codec are executed and no archive comparison changes current semantic admission.
independent_reviews.test_result_boundary: Inspected malformed-null, source tamper, write-once, context split, incomplete/failed and native-only fixtures. Implementer reported full suite running; this independent reviewer has not claimed its final result.

independent_reviews.mode: Read-only collaborating-agent source, documentation and receipt review; no new Cargo, compiler or engine executions for this evidence projection.
independent_reviews.final_source_identity_check: All 21 source/build/test hashes in the final affected-suite receipt were checked against both frozen commit contents and the working tree; every receipt log hash was recomputed.
reviewed_boundaries: Canonical Boolean types are normalized after desugaring; ordinary integer typedefs do not acquire a Boolean-range proof, and evaluation count and int result are preserved.
Each rendered payload style retains the candidate source basis; source identity is not collapsed by native ELF equality.
Finite snapshot and aggregate reader bounds are compatible, and unretained candidates cannot be measured or admitted.
Signal termination is incomplete; failed compositions retain component identities; size-only and compile-only observations do not imply semantic admission.
Explicit admitted decisions require recorded native/diagnostic identity matching the reproduced baseline; malformed/null metadata cannot create selected status.
Final error paths preserve original search failures alongside archive-sealing or secondary failure-receipt write errors; the latter final hunk is distinguished from the earlier full-suite snapshot.
Archive comparison ranks retained historical measurements within declared contexts and does not import edits, execute recorded commands, or grant new acceptance.
independent_reviews.review_result: No remaining blocking finding in the reviewed scope; not a universal equivalence proof or a human PR approval.

interpretation.counts_are_not_additive: The 8-case Boolean rerun and 4-case final affected-suite rerun overlap the full suite; they are not 77 distinct tests or a 65-case execution on exact final source.
